title: Stereographic Multiple-Try Metropolis
abstract: arXiv:2505.12487v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multiple-proposal MCMC algorithms have recently gained attention for their potential to improve performance, especially through parallel implementation on modern hardware. We introduce Stereographic Multiple-Try Metropolis (SMTM), a novel family of gradient-free algorithms designed for sampling high-dimensional distributions. By integrating multiple-try Metropolis (MTM) with the stereographic MCMC framework, SMTM overcomes the traditional limitations of MTM, particularly its pathological convergence behavior often observed in high dimensions. For both light-tailed and heavy-tailed targets, SMTM not only outperforms classical MTM and the existing stereographic random-walk Metropolis but also demonstrates strong robustness to tuning. These advantages are supported by high-dimensional scaling analysis and validated through extensive simulation studies.

translated_title: 球极投影多重尝试Metropolis算法
translated_abstract: 多重提议MCMC算法最近因其提升性能的潜力而备受关注，尤其是在现代硬件上的并行实现方面。本文提出了球极投影多重尝试Metropolis（SMTM），这是一类新颖的无梯度算法族，专为高维分布采样而设计。通过将多重尝试Metropolis（MTM）与球极投影MCMC框架相结合，SMTM克服了MTM的传统局限性，特别是其在高维空间中经常出现的病态收敛行为。对于轻尾和重尾目标分布，SMTM不仅优于经典MTM和现有的球极投影随机游走Metropolis算法，还对参数调优表现出很强的鲁棒性。这些优势得到了高维缩放分析的支持，并通过广泛的模拟研究得到验证。
tldr: 本文提出球极投影多重尝试Metropolis（SMTM）算法，通过将多重尝试Metropolis与球极投影MCMC框架结合，克服了MTM在高维空间中的病态收敛问题，在轻尾和重尾目标分布上均优于经典方法且对调参具有强鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Stereographic Multiple-Try Metropolis (SMTM), a gradient-free algorithm family that integrates multiple-try Metropolis with the stereographic MCMC framework to overcome MTM's pathological convergence in high dimensions, outperforming classical methods with strong robustness to tuning for both light-tailed and heavy-tailed targets.
